# FindBuyAgent

> Non-custodial agent payments on Base with x402. A marketplace of live-verified paid APIs, and one-time burner budgets run by GitHub Actions.

## Marketplace
- [Index (JSON)](https://blockchains.github.io/findbuyagent/marketplace/index.json): every listed service with price, category, endpoint, last verification and rating
- [Live data](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/findbuyagent-vault/main/market/market.json), refreshed three times a day
- Rate a service: POST https://api.github.com/repos/Blockchains/findbuyagent-vault/issues with title "Rating: <slug>" and body {"slug":"<slug>","stars":1-5}
